description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• Design, execute and lead a research project focused on translational control in cancer

• Drive the development and advance our single-cell ribosome profiling strategies in mouse models of cancer

• Contribute to the development and optimization of new experimental and computational methods within the field of translational control

• Collaborate within an interdisciplinary team and participate in mentoring PhD and Master's students

Anforderungen:
• Ph.D. in molecular biology, cancer biology or similar domain

• Strong expertise and experience in RNA biology and translational control is required, supported by at least one publication/preprint in the field.

• Experience with single-cell techniques, ribosome profiling and/or mouse models of cancer is a plus

• A high degree of independence and self-motivation is expected

• Strong communications skills, written and oral (English)

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. More
